cita: Binance will delist and cease redemption for the TRXUP, TRXDOWN, DOTUP, DOTDOWN, LINKUP and LINKDOWN leveraged tokens at the following timings: At 2023-05-09 06:00 (UTC) : TRXUP, TRXDOWN At 2023-05-10 06:00 (UTC) : DOTUP, DOTDOWN At 2023-05-11 06:00 (UTC) : LINKUP, LINKDOWN
motivo_omision: La extracción generó eventos para TRXDOWN, DOTUP, DOTDOWN y LINKUP del mismo anuncio, pero no para TRXUP ni LINKDOWN.
